jei.reikotrains.info.track: The mod's own track. Place it and it runs the way you're facing (diagonals too); blocks in a line join up. Hold it, click a track block, then where the line should go, to lay a curve, ramp or junction (sneak for S-bends). A curve costs a piece a block of its length.
jei.reikotrains.info.street_track: Track set into the road, its rails level with the top, so cars and people go over it. Put it in place of a road block; draw curves between street track blocks as with train track, as tight as a radius of 3 blocks.
jei.reikotrains.info.steam_locomotive: A green tank engine, six blocks long. Click track with it to put it on the line. It burns coal (or charcoal, logs...) and needs water too: click it with fuel or a water bucket. Click it empty-handed to drive: W/S throttle, Space brake, A/D at junctions.
jei.reikotrains.info.express_locomotive: The big steam engine: eight blocks long, a third faster than the tank engine and nearly twice as strong. It burns coal and water from a Tender coupled to it.
jei.reikotrains.info.tender: Carries the express's coal (128 pieces' worth) and water (64 buckets). Couple it to the express; click either with fuel to fill it.
jei.reikotrains.info.diesel_locomotive: A road-switcher that runs on BuildCraft Reborn's diesel (Dense Fuel or Mixed Heavy Fuels). It pulls harder than either steam engine. Fill it with buckets, pipes or a wagon loader.
jei.reikotrains.info.electric_locomotive: A box-cab electric that runs on BuildCraft power (MJ) in its batteries: the strongest engine. Charge it at a charging point, or run it under overhead wires.
jei.reikotrains.info.bullet_train: A Bullet Train driving car: about 100 km/h. Put one at each end of a set, noses out, with Bullet Train Coaches between; drive it from either end. Runs on batteries, or from overhead wires.
jei.reikotrains.info.bullet_coach: A Bullet Train coach, with twelve seats: goes between the set's two driving cars.
jei.reikotrains.info.vintage_tram: A single-car tram for street track and overhead wires. It runs both ways: get in at the end you want to lead. It keeps to street rules, stopping for anything on the track ahead.
jei.reikotrains.info.low_floor_tram: A modern three-section tram that bends round street corners: click a track block to put all three sections on together. It runs from overhead wires and keeps to street rules.
jei.reikotrains.info.passenger_coach: Eight seats in four rows. Click it to sit down; passengers see the station names as they go.
jei.reikotrains.info.freight_wagon: Holds 108 stacks, all on one screen. Hoppers above or below it, and wagon loaders, fill and empty it. A full one is heavier to pull.
jei.reikotrains.info.tank_wagon: Carries 256 buckets of one fluid. Fill and empty it with buckets, pipes or a wagon loader; its gauge shows how full it is.
jei.reikotrains.info.livestock_wagon: Six stalls for animals: lead them up to it and click it to load them, sneak-click to let them out. A wagon loader loads them from a pen.
jei.reikotrains.info.car_transporter: Carries the cars of Reiko's Car Mod: with the train stopped, drive up to a free end and keep going to drive aboard. Sit in a car and keep going to drive off.
jei.reikotrains.info.guards_van: Goes on the back of the train: two seats and a stove inside. Its brake makes the whole train stop quicker, and its handbrake holds wagons left without an engine.
jei.reikotrains.info.track_layer: Put it at the front of a train, load it with track and stone, dirt or gravel, and drive off the end of the line: it lays track ahead of itself at a walk, digging through hills and filling dips to keep the line level. Steer for a 45° bend.
jei.reikotrains.info.coupler: Click a train car, then the car next to it, to couple them. Sneak-click a car to uncouple it.
jei.reikotrains.info.signal: Put it beside the track, looking the way trains go: red while a train is on the line ahead, green when it's clear. Trains stop for red. Redstone holds it at red.
jei.reikotrains.info.three_light_signal: A signal that also shows yellow while the next signal is red: trains pass it at caution speed, ready to stop.
jei.reikotrains.info.signal_box: Click it for a live map of the railway round it, trains and all. Click a switch on the map to throw it, or a signal to hold it at red.
jei.reikotrains.info.switch_stand: Put it beside a junction: trains go the way it's set. Click it to throw it; redstone sets and holds it. Sneak-click to choose what redstone does.
jei.reikotrains.info.station: A nameboard beside the track. Click it to name it and set how long trains wait. Timetabled trains stop at it, and it gives a redstone signal while a train stands there.
jei.reikotrains.info.timetable: Click stations with it, in order, then click a train with it: the train runs between them by itself. Click a station twice to have the train leave or pick up wagons there.
jei.reikotrains.info.water_tower: Fills the tank engines and tenders of a train standing beside it with water. Fill it with buckets or pipes; it holds 256 buckets.
jei.reikotrains.info.turntable: Use it on flat ground: it digs its own pit, 15 blocks across, and turns trains round on its bridge. Click it to turn the bridge to the next track.
jei.reikotrains.info.engine_shed: Big doors for the end of an engine shed: use them on straight track. They open for trains, and engines standing inside are topped up from their store.
jei.reikotrains.info.charging_point: Charges the electrics, Bullet Trains and trams standing beside it, from BuildCraft engines, pipes or other mods' cables.
jei.reikotrains.info.catenary_mast: Put it beside the track: its arm holds overhead wire over the line. String Overhead Wire from mast to mast, up to 32 blocks apart.
jei.reikotrains.info.overhead_wire: Click a mast, then the next one along, to string a span of wire between them. Electrics, Bullet Trains and trams under a live wire run from it.
jei.reikotrains.info.substation: Powers an overhead line: put it within four blocks of one of its masts and feed it from BuildCraft engines, pipes or cables.
jei.reikotrains.info.speed_sign: Put it beside the track facing the trains: they slow down for its limit and keep to it until the next sign. Click it to change the limit.
jei.reikotrains.info.track_sensor: Gives a redstone signal while a train is over the track beside it. Click it to choose which way trains must be going; click it with an item to sense only some trains.
jei.reikotrains.info.level_crossing: Put it beside a road where it crosses the line: its lamps flash, its bell rings and its arm comes down across the road while a train goes by.
jei.reikotrains.info.wagon_loader: Loads (or unloads) the freight, tank and livestock wagons of a train standing beside it, from the storage next to it. Click it for its filter; sneak-click to switch loading and unloading.
